# Literary Analysis Paragraph Scaffold

Subject: Writing
Grade band: 6-8
Resource type: Writing Scaffold
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards

## Short Description
A scaffold for writing a claim, embedding evidence, and explaining how the evidence proves the idea.

## Alignment Note
Supports literary analysis, evidence, reasoning, and academic paragraph structure.

## Classroom Use Case
Use after close reading when students need support moving from notes to analysis.

## Preview Content
- Claim about the text
- Evidence lead-in
- This shows...

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
